ValidationRule.description: Invoice Number, Invoice Amount, Open AR Amount are required when the Date Invoice Created is present.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS - RM' && (NOT( ISBLANK( Date_Invoice_Created__c )) && ( ISBLANK( Invoice_Amount__c ) || ISBLANK( Invoice_Number__c) || ISBLANK( Open_AR_Amount__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Number, Invoice Amount, and Open AR Amount are required when the Date Invoice Created is present.
